trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Nothing on the list needs multiplayer or DLC: every trophy is single-player and there are no online trophies. PowerPyx rates the whole run 4/10 and about 200 hours — long, not hard.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — and progress you made during the story already counts. PowerPyx stresses it is forgiving, closer to 60% true completion: any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars, any 70 of 80 challenges. Only a few lines need everything: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing toward 100% is missable.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts — for 100% you need 300. PowerPyx breaks them down as 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix categories freely; flying under bridges is the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check them under Touchpad, Progress, Activities. PowerPyx notes you will do one of each naturally while chasing the other trophies, so don't force it.

trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you a fishing location marked with a purple icon on the map. trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: There are 4 arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; the fourth is on arcade machines around the world. To complete a game, finish all of its levels at least once — you don't need every challenge. Pick the one you like best.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3. While playing as Lucia you will get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address that marks the questline in Belville. Finish all 5 of her quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. Everything is still available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1. A while after the mission Island Dreams, he calls you and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you treasure diving at shipwrecks: find the underwater treasures with the metal detector and bring them back. In total he wants 7 shipwrecks cleared. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2-3, so nothing is missable — PowerPyx notes calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 can speed his return. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish all 5 of his quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler), and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Only certain stranger questlines count — PowerPyx warns that Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. Confirmed counting strands: Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (the street-race mentorship), and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile and his deliveries). All of them are still findable after the story in free-roam, and more counting strangers are still being discovered.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered — the list runs from the Pegassi Infernus and Tempesta to the Grotti Itali RSX and Bravado Banshee. Track the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List; scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is wanted, then drive it to his garage in the west of Vice City. Delivering in good condition pays more. Still doable after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City — go and destroy them as part of Take Out Kitty Litter. After enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This, which unlocks the trophy. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts as +2. Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. MISSABLE — the one meditation that can be lost: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning. She says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony at Jason's house — follow her and choose Accept. PowerPyx notes this one raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a meditation spot like the rest, and it is still unclear whether it is required for the trophy — the writer earned the trophy after doing it. Do it anyway: it costs a minute and protects the run. The final spot needs both characters together, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons — hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. Honest note: PowerPyx says it is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops this trophy, so follow Bret's requests in order and track the 15 Target Decks under Map, Activities — all 15 are needed for 100% anyway.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx links a full guide to all 18 card set locations, so you can plan a route instead of wandering. Card sets are a pure collectible grind — save them for cleanup, after the story and the 100% checklist are done.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK scans are objects in the world you scan by holding Up and then R1. There are far more than 100 to find — PowerPyx counts 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — so it doesn't matter which 100 you scan. Scan everything you pass while doing other trophies and this will finish itself.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: There are 80 challenges and you only need 50 for this trophy — for 100% you need any 70, so this pops automatically along the way. View and track them under Progress, Challenges. Most complete naturally while you work on the other trophies; leave this for one of your last trophies, then pick the easiest and quickest of the ones remaining.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: First unlock free-roam with both characters together — that comes after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle, then cause carnage until you reach a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. PowerPyx's easiest route: drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter can't see you. The trophy pops after you drive out of the heat zone. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, and while robbing the large bank vaults for 100%.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle), then hit 3 robbery targets in a row — the green icons on the map — while staying wanted the whole time. Keep the red-and-blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Gear up first: an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. PowerPyx's best spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — rob a couple of items and the back-room safe in each. The pop is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it doesn't come, hit a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: The game has 557 vehicles at launch — cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes. Open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to use it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Scanning is enough; you don't need to drive it. The fastest method per PowerPyx is to stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. You need 200 base-model vehicles scanned for 100%, so this pops automatically. Check totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus activates with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar. You must down 5 enemies in one use, and it only lasts a few seconds. Buff your focus first — eat or drink, wash your face or shower at home, and take Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to extend it. Then line up 5 enemies — PowerPyx suggests criminals at gang operations — and drop them fast with an accurate full-auto weapon like the Duke 556, wearing body armor from Ammu-Nation. Note it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane sitting on the airfield. PowerPyx's easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get inside, go upstairs into the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport. The pop is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino. PowerPyx places them at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, standing in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. That unlocks the Snap Gun, for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and jewelry store robberies, marked automatically with a green icon on unfogged map areas. Break in through the back door using the Snap Gun — the gadget stays in your inventory, and approaching a locked door offers the kick (loud, triggers the alarm) or the Snap Gun (stealth). Inside, find the note with the safe code in the back room and loot the safe. PowerPyx's suggested spot is Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress. It introduces bank vault robberies: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, a guard carries a briefcase of cash inside and the vault opens — slip in while it is open and rob it. Bring your partner (hold Right to hand off a bag) because you can't carry all the cash alone. After the quest, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips — he needs his earlier quests done first, robbing 2 Payday Loans — and vans are marked with a purple icon. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level; escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total: 5 for this trophy, all 8 for 100%, paying up to $205,000 per bank.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This unlocks automatically in the same Chapter 4 optional mission as Maximum Withdrawal, That's Where The Money Is: robbing the vault of a large bank counts as robbing an armored truck, because you tail the truck to the bank. You need all 8 large bank jobs for 100% anyway, so this pops on the way. To get it earlier, block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests — then escape the red heat radius or use a Pay 'n' Spray.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map — all 52 areas of Leonida. PowerPyx's fastest method is a plane: fly over every black-fogged part of the map until the entire map is visible. Do it after the story, when you can fly freely, and pair it with stunt and vehicle-scanning runs.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal operations. For this trophy you only need 1 operation from each gang, but 100% needs all 39, so this pops on the way. Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress, Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown — no guide writer has published a verified method yet. The official description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach is the obvious first try, but that is our own reading of the description, not a verified method. trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only steal it after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs — hack into the car, drive forward through the window, and the pop comes slightly delayed once you are further down the street. Only this blue Banshee counts, not any other car; it is an easter egg nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. It is marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Buy sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation first — you need them to blow the safe. The three items: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. Not missable: if you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns later and you can come back for the rest.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, then Strength (the heart icon). Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a fitness club membership, and always go together with both characters (hold Right, press Triangle to call your partner): while one works out, the other automatically completes their training too, so you make double progress. Filter for fitness clubs on the map under Activities. You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — PSN tracks the count to 500. Turn on criminal profile notifications first (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile on): whenever an action affects your reputation you see a little demon face on the right of the screen. The profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — a permanent status from excessive violence that PowerPyx warns against, because cops get more aggressive. This comes naturally while working on every other trophy; if it is still short at the end, PowerPyx notes it can be farmed by running over civilians and cops with a car.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — but that is a guess, not a verified method. The official description, 'Second time's the charm', suggests retrying something after a first failure. This guide will not invent a method: try the Payday Loans angle first when you reach the prologue area, and check back when a method is confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, alone. The spawn is slightly random: sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside. If it is not there, drive away and come back. When the car is there, follow the path from it into the woods and you will see the UFO — a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — that unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. You need $250,000 delivered in total, counted across all robberies, not at once. It comes naturally while doing the robberies for 100% — a single bank vault pays up to $205,000, and vaults only open after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. The fastest way is the most expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. PowerPyx counts the shops at 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. This climbs on its own while you gear up for the other trophies.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — the 4 story-related garages don't count. Together they cost $160,000. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone; buy them through the app. The quickest way to the money is robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you wherever you are. You need enough garages first — each garage adds parking spots to register more vehicles, so finish Little Boxes before this one. Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then choose Respray and Register in his garage. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
